Cardano-Loans contracts refactored from PlutusTx to Aiken.
The following (new) features will be implemented:
・Minimum payments (negotiable term intervals)
・Compounding OR Fixed interest payments (negotiable yes/no + term intervals)
・Unbonded Repayments: Bond owners (i.e. the lender) can update the address that the borrower must make repayments to.
・Support for script-based staking credentials (as opposed to pubkey staking credentials)

・Refinance-able debt: this likely would require its own contract, but would allow borrowers to trustlessly advertise their desire to refinance an open loan to prospective lenders. This would also allow renegotiations with the current lender.
・Multi-Asset Loans: borrowers may be able to borrow multiple assets in a single loan
・Linkable Credit History: By introducing new Beacon Tokens, it may be possible to link together previously unrelated/pseudonymous borrower IDs into a set of related (but still pseudonymous) IDs, at the borrower's discretion.

ms.promise:
Cardano-Options contracts refactored from PlutusTx to Aiken.
The following (new) features will be implemented:
・Script-based Payment address: enables option writers to receive payments to script addresses, in addition to pubkey addresses. Currently, this would require additional logic, but may be much easier to enforce with upcoming updates to Plutus Core.
・Burning Both ContractID Tokens: Currently, one of the ContractIDs is burned when an option is exercised, and the other is included in one of the outputs to prevent double satisfaction. In Cardano-Options V2, double satisfaction can be prevented using datums, allowing both contractID tokens to be burned, mitigating UTxO/token bloat.
・Variable minUTxO Deposits: Currently, minUTxO deposits are hardcoded for certain UTxOs in the option lifecycle. V2 will enable variable deposits through the use of an extra datum field + logic, lowering deposit costs.
・Buying Multiple Options: V2 will enable buying multiple options from different writers in the same transaction, increasing composability and lowering overall costs.

ms.promise:
Cardano-Aftermarket contracts refactored from PlutusTx to Aiken.
The following (new) features will be implemented:
・Updating Multiple Sales: V2 will add the ability to update sale parameters (i.e. price) of multiple listings in one Tx, improving efficiency and lowering overall costs.
・Batch (Multi-asset) Sales: Currently, only one NFT can be sold per "sale" UTxO. V2 will enable "batching" multiple NFTs of the same PolicyID into a single "Sale" UTxO. This improves the efficiency of the protocol, lowering overall costs.
・Bids: an essential feature for aftermarket protocols, especially for unique NFTs related to art, gaming, or membership. V2 may enable "bids", where prospective buyers would be able to send "Bid" UTxOs to the seller's market address, leaving the final sale decision up to the seller.
・Script-based Payments: V2 will enable sellers' flexibility in picking their preferred payment address.

ms.promise:
A desktop client GUI for interaction with the P2P-DeFi protocol suite will be created.
Featuring:
・Fixed API endpoint for querying chain indexers (i.e. blockfrost, Koios)
・Transaction builder for selecting/managing UTxOs, proceeding with workflow, managing state.
・Viewer module for checking the status of addresses/UTxOs engaged in one or more of the protocols' lifecycles.

The GUI is essentially a minimalist "wallet" specially designed for interacting with the P2P-DeFi family. Desktop client development is a higher priority than a browser-based app due to the former being more flexible/robust from a networking standpoint, especially in hostile environments.
Additionally, video + written tutorials / demos of usage of the whole P2P-DeFi protocol suite via the GUI will be created. Videos will go over simple usage of each protocol individually, composition within each protocol, and advanced compositions/workflows using multiple protocols. Benchmarks will be provided for multi-protocol Tx composition.
Note: The GUI is essentially a frontend wrapped over the CLI program mentioned in the original proposal. The CLI program will be included, though it is not meant for end users, but for dev
ms.criteria: The GUI is able to serve as an effective frontend for interacting with the P2P-DeFi protocol suite, lowering the barrier-to-entry for non-technical and technical users who do not or cannot use the CLI. Videos and benchmarks should enable users to follow along and reproduce the same workflows (and throughput) as demonstrated.

ms.promise:
Project closeout video and report will summarize the achievements and future directions of the project.
Additionally, a thesis paper, dubbed "P2P-DeFi Manifesto" will tie together the protocol suite into one high level architectural & philosophical overview document. It will serve as the raison d'être of the project, and as a guide for future directions/considerations.
ms.criteria: The thesis paper will expound on the principles and ideals that went into creating the P2P-DeFi protocol family. It will stress the importance, feasibility, and downright necessity of fully trustless P2P DeFi protocols in the blockchain industry, and why Cardano is the ideal platform for such an ecosystem. The paper can be thought of as a greatly expanded version of the closeout video/report, tying the project together from beginning to end.
